args.title: Parse and clean currency symbols before storing amounts
args.body:
File: src/db/repos/transactionRepo.ts

Add parsing and cleaning steps in transactionRepo.ts to remove currency symbols like the rupee sign from amounts before converting and storing them as bigints. This will fix the import error caused by strings such as `₹1,250.00` that cannot be converted directly.

label: bug
file: src/db/repos/transactionRepo.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The file transactionRepo.ts is the place where transactions and amounts as bigints are handled. The problem is that it does not currently parse or clean currency symbols like the rupee sign before storing, which causes import failures. Adding this parsing there will fix the problem.
